messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected for model-family=marlin9b in us-west-2, 5xx spike and token per minute (TPM) surge starting 10:12 UTC. Aggregated 5xx rate = 6.8% over 5m.
Patricia (oncall): saw it, paging in. linking graphs: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1977771234
Dan (oncall): i'm on the pager, checking SLO dashboards and per-customer throttles. any customer-y spikes?
Maya (eng-sre): quick glance — traffic has a heavy prefix of long-context generation calls, kv-cache miss rate up. TPM for marlin9b jumped ~3x on a few routes. 429s starting to show for standard tier.
Patricia (oncall): ok mitigation options: 1) global RPM cap for marlin9b 2) carve out per-tenant higher TPM 3) disable long-context endpoint as emergency, 4) reduced concurrency on serving pool. thoughts?
Josh (infra): can push a temporary sculpt via rate-limiter API. ETA ~2m. example command: 
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.redwood/internal/rate-limiter/sculpt \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOKEN' \
  -d '{"model_family":"marlin9b","rpm":300,"tpm":900,"reason":"emergency sculpt - 5xx surge"}'
```
Patricia (oncall): i'd prefer conservative approach: lower RPM to 300 across standard tier, keep TPM at 900 for now so in-flight long generations can finish. create carveouts for enterprise tenants that need higher throughput. Dan, can you coordinate the carveouts list?
Dan (oncall): will do. @Lee can you list the customers we should exempt? also flag any SLA risks.
Lee (customer-success): on it. Tentative carveouts: AcmeCorp (dedicated), NebulaApps (paid plan), Sovrin Labs (enterprise). I'll ping each and get agreement to temporary limits.
Maya (eng-sre): i pushed a quick-probe to canary nodes. 5xx origin seems to be increased KV-store latency leading to OOM fallback in some runtime shards. If we shave RPM we should reduce tail.
Patricia (oncall): Josh, go ahead with the sculpt. Use the curl payload but add an exceptions list returned by Dan (will update). Keep the window 30min and auto-roll back if 5xx < 1% and latency stable.
Josh (infra): applying now. command executed, change-id=chg_197777A.
DeployBot: rate-limit change chg_197777A applied to cluster marlin9b-us-west-2 by josh; rpm=300, tpm=900; auto-rollback=30m.
Dan (oncall): creating carveout list now. i'll attach the tenant ids and a narrower tpm for each to avoid total capacity bleed.
Dan (oncall): carveouts payload (example): 
```
{"exceptions":[{"tenant_id":"acct-acme","rpm":800,"tpm":2500},{"tenant_id":"acct-nebula","rpm":600,"tpm":1800}]}
```
Josh (infra): accepted list, applied exceptions for acct-acme and acct-nebula. change-id=chg_197777B.
Patricia (oncall): initial telemetry after sculpt: 5xx dropped to 2.1% in 3m, p95 latency down 18%. Good. Keep monitoring.
Lee (customer-success): AcmeCorp acknowledged — they saw degraded throughput but app still functional; they asked for ETA on full recovery. I told them we're monitoring and may extend 30m if needed.
Maya (eng-sre): runtime logs indicate one shard had a bad kernel causing memory fragmentation under bursts. we've queued a patch but it's non-trivial. Deferring to runtime team for targeted restart later during maintenance window.
Patricia (oncall): decision: keep sculpt in place for next 20m, extend auto-rollback to 45m if stability continues. no full disable of long-context for now. Dan & Lee to handle carveout comms. Maya to follow up with runtime on patch timeline.
DeployBot: change chg_197777A extended to 45m by patricia; new auto-rollback at +45m.
Josh (infra): noted. I'll stand by to revert earlier if any enterprise customer reports major outage.
Dan (oncall): carveouts communicated to CS, will post list here once final.
Patricia (oncall): thanks team. keep thread for updates only; if any regression -> page.
IncidentBot: incident created INC-197777, severity=3, mitigation in place: per-model RPM sculpt for marlin9b.
Patricia (oncall): closing for now — monitoring + followups scheduled.
note: This thread documents a live mitigation where engineers applied an emergency per-model RPM/TMP sculpt with tenant carveouts to reduce 5xxs and latency; contains commands used and change ids for auditing.
